column1: # tools/shots/ink_ref_xcui.tsv (1.4.1 D2: docs/R1_4_1_CONTRACT.md §1.5, §2; made in 1.4 D1d, docs/M7D.md "UI テストの 2 回目
# の写真"): the ink tiles of complete XCUITest photos, for tools/shots/xcui_ink.py, which checks the photos of build.yml's
# ui-tests and span-shots-app with tools/shots/ink_check.swift (its head has the line's format) and only warns. Made
# with `xcui_ink.py ref` from the first full 1.4.1 run, build.yml 44926505978 (r141 b02b279; image macos27
# 20261104.0337.1, Xcode 27.2 27B52, iOS 27.2 24B8117, the iPad mini iOS 27.0 24A434). 1.4.1 changed every photo's
# header band, so 1.4's lines (run 44676125566, r14 755d611) read it as handwriting missing in that run: 64 of the 66
# ui-tests photos with a line (px box …,240-…,431; the landscape YearTap photos at x 1056-1151, where their header lies
# turned) and 63 of the 64 span-shots-app photos.
# - "ui-tests/<class>/<test> :: <attachment's name>" (the name in the attachments' manifest.json): the artifact ui-tests
#   (attempt 1, iPhone 17: 67 tests, 17 skipped, none failed, A1 too). 1.4's 66 names in 1.4's order, then one new name:
#   PaletteMoveUITests' "palette UI — phone.png" (1.4.1: the week page of screenshot mode, asked for the left edge, the
#   bar kept at the bottom). Left out, as in 1.4 and as tools/shots/ink_ref.tsv leaves out sheets other than the lasso:
#   the settings sheet's "setting — the switch off.png" and "setting — the switch on.png" (each run stops its scroll
#   elsewhere) and LanguageUITests' paywall-de-top.png and paywall-de-bottom.png. The create sheet of B3 ("after
#   予定にする") stays: it shows the selected handwriting.
# - "span-shots-app/<file>" (the PNGs of shots/span-app): the artifact span-shots-app of attempt 2 (attempt 1's job was
#   cut off and its artifact holds only part of the photos): 64 photos.
# Compared with 1.4's lines tile by tile, no tile outside the header band lost ink. ui-tests: 35 lines (27 portrait and
# the 8 landscape YearTap ones) gained the blue ring of the black pen's colour well in the toolbar, 1,812 px in 8 tiles
# (x 816-959, y 2352-2495; turned, x 96-239, y 1008-1151): 1.4's photos were taken after A1 had failed and left the pen
# The ui-tests lines then leave out the blue (class 3) tiles of the toolbar's colour wells, where that ring lies: tile
# turned landscape photos; 44 lines, 342 tiles, 91,842 px. The ring shows the pen chosen, not handwriting: a run whose
# A1 fails and leaves the pen red takes the photos after it without the ring, and with those tiles each of them would be
# warned of as about 1,812 px short, burying a real loss among them.
# A name not here is not checked. Renew a line with `xcui_ink.py ref` from a complete photo of the same Xcode, runtime
# and image, and leave the colour wells' blue tiles out of a ui-tests line as above.
# The line of span-shots-app/iphone-landscape-margin-day-single.png: 1.4's photo had the Dynamic Island at x 0-191,
# y 384-815 (its 32 tiles were dropped from 1.4's line, 5d0af89); this run's photo has none, so the line holds no such
# tiles, and a photo with the Island only gains ink there.
